name: lodash-capitalize-generator-react-reflux
behavioral_change: lodash 4.0.0 changed `_.capitalize` so that v_new lowercases every character after the first, whereas v_old left them unchanged. The function name, arity and call form are unchanged, and results differ only for inputs with uppercase letters after the first character.
downstream_effect: The downstream project (generator-react-reflux) passes lodash into its Yeoman templates, which compute names such as `lodash.capitalize(path.basename(actionsName) + 'Actions')`; after the upgrade `UserActions` becomes `Useractions` inside the generated files while the file paths stay correct. The four failures are yeoman-assert messages such as `did not match '/var UserActions /'` with frames only in `node_modules/yeoman-assert` and the two test files; lodash, `capitalize` and the template files are never mentioned.
reference_fix: The reference fix replaces `_.capitalize` with `_.upperFirst` at eighteen sites across eight production files (four Yeoman templates, two generator entry files and two component templates).
documented_in: The lodash Changelog v4.0.0 (https://github.com/lodash/lodash/wiki/Changelog#v400), section Compatibility Warnings, states the new `_.capitalize` behavior with an inline link to `_.upperFirst` (https://lodash.com/docs#upperFirst), which is listed among the added methods under Notable Changes. Tier 2: no old versus new code is shown.
